blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra was glad to see Isaac Go put together a vital performance in Game 1 of their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series with sister team San Miguel Beer on Tuesday. Go’s 14 points and four rebounds in 19 minutes helped the Gin Kings take a 104-95 win at Smart Araneta Coliseum, delivering perhaps his best game since returning from a knee injury last March. He was glad to step up, especially when his two triples set up Ginebra’s pullaway, while also sharing the duties of guarding June Mar Fajardo. “It’s always a […]...
